notes.EO:830: Held text is a Wikisource mirror transcription of a one-person grant of eligibility. No held source shows the appointment was made, so exhaustion by performance cannot be claimed under the 2026-10-28 ruling, and no held later order names it.
notes.EO:5917: One-person exemption from compulsory retirement under section 204 of the 1933 Legislative Branch appropriation act. The statute is not held and no held source shows Davis's separation; a bounded search for the number found only the order's own text.
notes.EO:2655: Held text is a Wikisource mirror transcription of a one-person grant. No held source shows Ritenour was appointed; the cruden number search found only the order's own text and the neighbouring Wikisource pages EO_2654 and EO_2656 (navigation links), not an ending.
notes.EO:276: Held text is a Wikisource mirror transcription of a one-person grant. No held source shows Cooper was appointed; the number search found only navigation links on the neighbouring Wikisource pages EO_275 and EO_277, not an ending.
notes.EO:351: Own terms contain no end. The held number hits for 'Executive Order No. 351' (EO 8393 and its copies) concern a different instrument, a 1929 order of the Governor of Hawaii, so they are not later events for this order. No held source shows Rule XII clause 2 was extinguished for these removals.
